title: Random Pick With Blacklist
description: Pick a random integer in [0, n - 1] that is not in the blacklist using a mapping strategy.
pseudocode:
1. M = n - len(blacklist)
2. map = {}
3. last = n - 1
4. for b in blacklist:
5.   if b < M:
6.     while last in blacklist:
7.       last -= 1
8.     map[b] = last
9.     last -= 1
10. pick = random(0, M-1)
11. return map.get(pick, pick)

steps.note: Find swap target: 4 is not in blacklist.
